notes.title: Update - Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
- Added a rotating symbol on level 2 to guide and encourage players to use the smoke to change the direction of their rotation.

- Fixed bug where main menu screen was frozen after returning from end game screen

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update - Version 1.0.3 (New Save System)
notes.notes:
- Implemented a new Save system. When you close the game or return to menu you will now be able to continue from the last level you were playing

- Fixed a bug where the sound for passing a level was playing twice

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Small Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Buttons weren't working for controllers on end game screen (Fixed)
- Added Restarts counter in the pause screen
- Boss bat increases speed after HP reaches 50%
